cover_letter.greeting: Dear DoorDash Marketplace Strategy & Operations Team,
paragraphs: I'm applying for the Senior Associate role on DoorDash's Marketplace Strategy & Operations team, focused on Restaurant Growth. I'm an MBA (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. What interests me is that the role owns real revenue goals, and the job is to figure out which selection, merchandising and partnership bets actually grow the marketplace.

At JPMorgan Asset Management I built cross-platform campaign analytics to track KPIs, and the campaigns reached a 135% increase in engagements while media spend fell by up to 83%. I also benchmarked past marketing-channel budget allocations, which found 30% in efficiency gains. At Lenovo I built forecasts and scenario analyses on capital allocation that improved capital efficiency by 15%, and defined audience segmentation and business requirements for campaigns that improved campaign ROI by 20%.

That maps to growing marketplace revenue with data and working across Product, Analytics, Finance and Sales. Restaurant marketplaces would be new to me, so I'd start by learning how merchants and Dashers experience the product. I'm comfortable pulling data in SQL, modeling in Excel, and letting the numbers settle an argument. I'd welcome the chance to talk.
